We’d love to help you choose – think of us as your hydration matchmakers.
Here are a few options depending on how you’ll use it:
All‑day mega hydration / festivals / gym crew → Big Mouth Bottle (2L or 4L), keeps drinks cold up to 72 hours, hot up to 48 hours, fully leak‑proof, great with ice and even fizzy or alcoholic drinks.
Everyday insulated bottle → Series 3 Bottle (350ml, 500ml, 1L). Double‑walled, 36–60 hours cold (more for Flip), 100% leak‑proof, not dishwasher safe, great for regular water on the go.
Hot coffee/tea on commute → Series 2 Coffee Cup (340ml or 500ml). Double‑walled, twist lid, very leak‑resistant when upright; hand‑wash only, no microwave/dishwasher/freezer.
Hot + cold, straw or sip → Series 2 Switch Cup (500ml or 750ml). Rotating lid switches between straw mode and cup mode, works for hot or cold (hot drinks only in cup mode), insulated for several hours, not dishwasher safe, can be used with fizzy drinks and ice.
On‑the‑go eating → Cutlery Set. Stainless steel fork, knife, spoon, telescopic straw + brush in a compact case; some parts dishwasher safe (utensils), others hand‑wash only – perfect for lunches and picnics.
Payment flexibility (UK, orders over £60) → You can use Klarna to Pay in 3 installments or in 30 days, interest‑free when paid on time.
If you tell us:
what you drink most (water, coffee, fizzy, mixed),
where you’ll use it (office, gym, commute, festivals), and
how much you usually drink,
we can point you to the exact size and product that’ll fit you best.

I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
If you’re trying to keep things budget‑friendly with us, a few options stand out:
Use Klarna (orders over £60):
Pay in 3 monthly instalments, or
Pay in 30 days, both interest‑free when paid on time.
Choose lower-value gift cards: £10, £25, £50 or £100, and you can combine multiple if needed.
Factor in minimums for bulk orders: We can’t go below 30 units per size and color, so that’s your lowest entry point for co-branded or bulk orders.
Delivery on bulk within budget: For UK, EU and Switzerland bulk orders, delivery is already included in the unit cost, which helps keep the total predictable.
Plenty of payment methods: You can pay with major cards, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and some local methods, so you can use whichever fits your financial setup best.
